title: Telemetry hierarchy + honest topology
objective: Make Jaeger's System Architecture graph reflect REAL two-mesh topology: per-mesh service nodes (service.name=<mesh>.<type>), standard W3C trace propagation over QUIC, and removal of the admin-ui observability CC. No half measures.
size: small-medium — single engineer, stacks on sprint-12
in_scope: B1: deterministic node_name = <mesh>.<type>.<abbrev><N> (mesh1.gateway.gw1); admin-ui assigns + passes RAFKA_NODE_NAME and derives the 3 OTel fields from the 3 segments
B2: rafka-telemetry build_resource() must emit service.namespace + service.instance.id (currently only SERVICE_NAME; Resource::new replaces env detection so OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES is dropped today)
B3: replace hand-rolled TracedFrame context with the global W3C propagator (inject/extract traceparent + tracestate) over the QUIC frame carrier (rafka-mesh-ops encode/decode_with_context)
B4: remove the gateway->admin-ui write CC; derive the Messages tab from a legit observation path (gossiped frames_recv_total or a real read subscription)

B5 (REQUIRED — missing broker activity is a telemetry flaw): write-sim moves open_uni -> open_bi; broker extracts the W3C context and opens its own action span(s) (produce.handle) parented to it, then writes an ACK back; the ACK carries the broker's span context so the gateway's ack-receive is a child -> broker->gateway edge. Full produce->handle->ack trace visible.
B6: add the service-name contract (B1 table) + the new produce.handle/ack spans + op_kind to CLAUDE.md §10 in the same commit
exit_criteria: Jaeger System Architecture shows DISTINCT per-mesh nodes: mesh1.gateway, mesh1.broker, mesh2.broker (+ compute/registry per mesh) — NOT a single collapsed 'broker'
The cross-mesh write is visible as mesh1.gateway -> mesh2.broker AND the ack as mesh2.broker -> mesh1.gateway (arrows BOTH ways)
A produce trace shows the broker's own work: gateway produce -> broker handle -> broker ack, one trace, broker spans parented by the propagated W3C context
NO gateway -> admin-ui artifact edge in the dependency graph
QUIC frames carry W3C traceparent + tracestate; a cross-mesh trace stitches end-to-end (verify in a Jaeger trace spanning gateway+broker across meshes)
node_name shows as mesh1.gateway.gw1-style in cache/topology/UI
UI + JAEGER screenshots (incl. the System Architecture graph) in docs/sprints/sprint-13/screenshots/
TEAM LEAD personally verified every screenshot; sprint-release.md/.html with embedded screenshots + Jaeger/admin links, opened
spans_to_emit: rafka.mesh.produce.handle (NEW — broker's own work, child of the propagated context)
rafka.mesh.produce.ack (NEW — broker->gateway ack; add to CLAUDE.md §10)

verification.method: Playwright UI capture + raw Jaeger UI capture INCLUDING the System Architecture dependency graph (jaeger-shot.js + a dependency-graph shot); team lead reruns cargo check, inspects a cross-mesh trace for traceparent/tracestate, eyeballs every PNG

infrastructure.jaeger_ui: http://localhost:16686 (System Architecture tab is the key proof)
